title: Not All LPs Are Equal: The Active-Passive Gap in Automated Market Maker Liquidity Provision
abstract: arXiv:2609.37963v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Liquidity provision in automated market makers is typically analyzed at the pool level, implicitly assuming LP homogeneity. This aggregate view can hide how liquidity provision outcomes differ between LP strategies, particularly as concentrated liquidity AMM designs operating on high-performance blockchains allow liquidity to be actively repositioned around trades. We develop a markout-based framework to decompose Uniswap LP profitability into active and passive components using two complementary methods: a LIFO subtraction method that matches short-lived mint-burn positions and attributes swap-level markouts by liquidity share; and an infinitesimal LP benchmark that estimates the performance of a fully passive, always-in-range marginal LP directly from the AMM price path.   We apply these methods to Uniswap v2, v3, and v4 pools on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Base chains, and find passive profitability can materially differ from aggregate po

translated_title: 并非所有流动性提供者都平等：自动做市商流动性提供中的主动—被动差距
translated_abstract: 自动做市商（AMM）中的流动性提供通常在资金池层面进行分析，隐含地假设流动性提供者（LP）是同质的。这种聚合视角可能掩盖不同LP策略之间流动性提供结果的差异，尤其是在高性能区块链上运行的集中流动性AMM设计允许流动性围绕交易被主动重新定位的情况下。我们开发了一个基于markout（交易后损益）的框架，采用两种互补方法将Uniswap LP的盈利能力分解为主动和被动两部分：一是LIFO（后进先出）扣减法，通过匹配短期的铸造—销毁头寸，并按流动性份额将交易层面的markout进行归属；二是无穷小LP基准法，直接从AMM价格路径估计一个完全被动、始终保持在区间内的边际LP的表现。我们将这些方法应用于以太坊、Arbitrum和Base链上的Uniswap v2、v3和v4资金池，发现被动盈利能力可能与聚合盈利能力存在实质性差异。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于markout的分解框架，将Uniswap LP的盈利能力拆分为主动与被动两部分，揭示了不同流动性提供策略之间存在显著的收益差距。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a markout-based framework that decomposes Uniswap LP profitability into active and passive components, revealing a significant performance gap between active and passive liquidity provision strategies.
